# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them through the repository's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/business-operations-agent/security/advisories/new) page. Include a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and potential impact. Do not include real credentials or customer data in a report.

The maintainers will review reports and coordinate any necessary updates. Response times may vary.
